title: Symbolic parameters for every item of the symbolic system: a general way beyond the scalar parameters of the user items
author: Claude-JG
description: Symbolic parameters are required in the long term; named parameters for the inertia of a rigid body and for the joints need a general solution (#3152 took the scalar parameters of the mass point and the spring-dampers). To design: parameters of any structure (an inertia from mass, inertia tensor and center of mass, the frames and axes of joints, the matrices of ObjectGenericODE2, the values of loads) given as named esym.Real or expressions of them, mapped to the numbers of the items; a parameter set per system (a VariableSet) instead of per item lists; the derivatives by them (sensitivities) through Equations and the composed system; later the C++ items with numerical and symbolic parameters (symbolicUserItems.md section 6).
workingRemarks: 2026-11-02: the bindings of the parameters of the user items are done (ParameterBindings, expressions of variables of mbs.symbolicVariables, revision2026c step RG12.67.2, #3207, #3208); open: the symbolic inertia and frames (RG12.67.3), the parameters as an input of the composed system (RG12.67.4), the sensitivities (RG12.67.5). Section 6 of symbolicUserItems.md, cited above, is now a decision in docs/dev/internals/userItems.md.; 2026-11-02: RigidBodyInertia and its shapes for symbolic values, the symbolic inertia of CreateRigidBody, the parameters of every Create function as expressions (revision2026c step RG12.67.3.1); open: the frames of joints and connectors (RG12.67.3.2), the parameters as an input of the composed system (RG12.67.4), the sensitivities (RG12.67.5).; 2026-11-03: the symbolic frames of joints and connectors not done (revision2026c step RG12.67.3.2 closed; user markers should resolve them); the forward sensitivities of the Python solvers abandoned (RG12.67.5 closed; numerical sensitivities are simpler, adjoint methods may come with advanced solvers); open: the parameters as an input of the composed system (RG12.67.4).
